name: yoloing-safe
description: YOLO mode safety net - PreToolUse guardrails that block destructive commands (rm -rf, disk formatting, data exfiltration), gate risky-but-maybe-intentional actions with host-aware behavior, and nudge the agent toward safer alternatives. Configurable credential file protection. Because shipping fast shouldn't mean losing your home directory.
